verdict.rationale: Bias reduction is a fair question for an applicant tracking system, so the axis applies. The pack only shows a generic candidate-rating API, a generic custom report builder, and MCP 'rate and review' operations. None of these documents structured feedback ordering, demographic-blind review, or DEI funnel reporting, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the platform helps reduce bias — structured feedback ordering, demographic-blind review options, and DEI reporting on the funnel
